newsitem.title: USA: Ashland unit plans Ohio/Kentucky pipeline.
newsitem.headline: Ashland unit plans Ohio/Kentucky pipeline.

text.p: Ashland Petroleum Co, a division of Ashland Inc, on Monday said it planned to build a petroleum products pipeline originating at Catlettsburg, Kentucky1, refinery and ending in central Ohio.

The company said preliminary engineering and feasibility studies had begun on the project, which is expected to begin construction in 1998. It said it was is considering a 16-inch diameter for the pipeline.

Ashland said that more than 90 percent of Catlettsburg's daily output of 220,000 barrels per day of refined products was currently transported by Ashland barges. The planned pipeline was not expected to have any impact upon Ashland's Canton, Ohio, refinery operations.
